def transform2(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=max(cnt, key=cnt.get)
    marker=next(v for v in cnt if v not in (0,bg))
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker]
    r0=min(i for i,j in pts); r1=max(i for i,j in pts); c0=min(j for i,j in pts); c1=max(j for i,j in pts)
    shape={(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pts}; h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(h-(r1-r0)):
        for c in range(w-(c1-c0)):
            cells=[(r+di,c+dj) for di,dj in shape]
            if all(g[i][j]==0 for i,j in cells):
                for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=marker
    return out

def transform3(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=max((v for v in cnt if v!=0),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    marker=next(v for v in cnt if v not in (0,bg))
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker]
    r0=min(i for i,j in pts); r1=max(i for i,j in pts); c0=min(j for i,j in pts); c1=max(j for i,j in pts)
    shape={(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pts}; h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(h-(r1-r0)):
        for c in range(w-(c1-c0)):
            cells=[(r+di,c+dj) for di,dj in shape]
            if all(g[i][j]==0 for i,j in cells):
                for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=marker
    return out
p=transform3(demo); print('demo1',p==expected,sum(a!=b for x,y in zip(p,expected) for a,b in zip(x,y)))
p=transform3(demo2); print('demo2',p==expected2,sum(a!=b for x,y in zip(p,expected2) for a,b in zip(x,y)))
